scope: Retrospective district diagnostics with a neutral national mean; no historical poll vintages. Curated era-specific presidential margins must predate the legislative election. This is not full chamber-control calibration.

spec.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of state clusters, deterministic seed 20261003

folds.excluded: Fewer than two prior election years
Fewer than two prior election years

decision: Use a 10-point residual uncertainty floor for newly imported presidential proxies, supported by historical undercoverage at 6 points and the most common earlier-years fit. The Brier difference interval includes zero; do not claim established accuracy gains. Transfer, mean structure, incumbency and other priors remain unchanged. This is not full-model calibration.
